qualification.method: Inherited runtime qualification from the manually tested v0.1.13 baseline
qualification.result: v0.1.14 is a metadata-only compatibility patch. The only runtime-facing changes are module version/download metadata and the Daggerheart compatibility declaration (minimum 1.2, verified 1.2, maximum 1.9). The release-candidate workflow rebuilt and validated all 15 Compendia successfully; rules, Compendium source content, scripts, assets, and mechanics are unchanged from the qualified v0.1.13 baseline.
